bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group predictive performance and calibration on a confounded version of the UCI Adult dataset, where subgroups are defined by binarized race and sex (e.g., Black Males, Non-Black Females).

Evaluating worst-group predictive performance and calibration on a confounded version of the UCI Adult dataset, where subgroups are defined by binarized race and sex (e.g., Black Males, Non-Black Females).
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS toxicity prediction benchmark across comments mentioning any of eight sensitive identity groups.
